name: AIBot (mc_aiplayer)
description: Server-side Fabric mod that adds an AI player to Minecraft which follows natural-language instructions through deterministic game tools.
whatItDoes: Creates a real server-spawned player that mines, crafts, builds and pursues goals when told to in chat or by command. It is for server owners who want an in-game assistant.
howItWorks: An LLM issues tool calls through an OpenAI-compatible API, and the mod maps them to a goal engine and task state machines running inside the server. It is built with Gradle and configured by a JSON file with permission profiles.

requirements.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
requirements.description: Key for the OpenAI-compatible model endpoint
